_source: Cross-service moderation aggregate for the ADMIN persona. The three surfaces and their queue/decision contracts are REAL catalyrst endpoints; the COUNTS below are a faithful synthetic snapshot because every admin read is bearer-gated (fail-closed) for an anonymous browser session. (1) PLACES reports: catalyrst-places GET /api/reports (handlers/admin.rs get_reports -> count_reports + list_reports), admin-bearer gated via require_admin_bearer (403 when PLACES_ADMIN_AUTH_TOKEN unset). Report status enum = open|resolved|dismissed|actioned (PATCH /api/reports/{id} ReportPatch ALLOWED set, handlers/admin.rs); rows = ReportRow {id, entity_id, reporter, status, resolution, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_at} (ports/places.rs). (2) COMMUNITIES: catalyrst-communities GET /v1/admin/communities (handlers/admin.rs list_communities, require_admin) with status=all|active|suspended|inactive over CommunityForModeration {id, name, ownerAddress, active, unlisted, createdAt, membersCount}; the suspension backlog read is GET /v1/moderation/communities (ports/moderation.rs ModerationComponent::all). Suspend/unsuspend = POST /v1/admin/communities/{id}/suspend|unsuspend. (3) EVENTS: catalyrst-events GET /events/api/events?list=all (handlers/events.rs get_event_list) returns approved/rejected/highlighted flags; bucketOf (app/lib/catalyst/whatson-admin.ts) maps {highlighted->featured, approved&&!rejected->approved, else->pending}. The anonymous list returns approved-only, so APPROVED-bucket counts can be derived live; pending/rejected are synthesized here. Upstream report-reason taxonomy mirrors decentraland/places-related moderation; community moderation states mirror decentraland communities (active/suspended/unlisted). Decision-rate + time-to-decision come from catalyrst-telemetry instrumentation of the three moderation wizards (admin_place_moderation_committed / admin_community_suspension_committed / whatson_event_moderated), read back via Metabase over the telemetry store — those events are the source of the 7d/30d decision counts, approval/dismissal split, and median SLA below.
_notes: Loader reads LIVE approved-event count from GET /events/api/events?list=all where reachable (it is anonymous-public) and falls back to the events bucket below on transport failure. Places + communities counts are always fixture (admin-gated). 'range' selects the 7d vs 30d decision window; queue depths are point-in-time (range-independent). SLA = time from report/submission created_at to resolved_at/moderated_at, in hours; medianSlaHours is the p50 across decisions in the window. The dashboard is READ-ONLY (no wizard); KPI cards deep-link into the matching moderation surface.
